ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Gpg.EXE Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed "gpg.exe". Often used by ransomware and loaders to decrypt/encrypt data.

sequences.query: process_original_file_name = "gpg\.exe" AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg2\\\.exe$")))
